card.line: Cush is a region south of Egypt, home to the descendants of Ham, where kings and peoples appear in God's words about nations and His promise to gather worshipers.

moments.title: Tirhakah of Cush Marches
moments.text: Sennacherib hears that Tirhakah, king of Cush, has set out to fight him. So he sends messengers again to Hezekiah, and Hezekiah spreads the letter out before the LORD.

moments.title: Cush Reaches Out to God
moments.text: The psalm says envoys will come from Egypt and Cush will stretch out her hands to God. The kingdoms of the earth are called to sing praises to Him.

moments.title: A Sign Against Egypt and Cush
moments.text: The LORD has Isaiah walk naked and barefoot for three years as a sign. Assyria will lead away captives of Egypt and Cush, and those who hoped in Cush will be ashamed.

moments.title: Worshipers from Beyond Cush
moments.text: The LORD says His scattered people from beyond the rivers of Cush will bring Him an offering. He promises to leave a humble people who trust in His name.
